what: Tool names, each labelled by what the tool does: A it acts (writes, sends, deletes, runs something), R it only reads, D debatable.
provenance: Each name was read on 2026-11-11 from the page in its `source`, and labelled from what that page says the tool does, by a collector who had not seen the reader's word lists. The list was collected after the word lists were fixed, and they have not been changed on it: what the reader scores here is out-of-sample.
